map.由质量与体积，按 ρ = m/V 计算物质密度。: Compute density from mass and volume with ρ = m/V in g/cm³ or kg/m³, for material identification and buoyancy checks.
map.水的密度约 1000 kg/m³；可用作物质识别参考。: Water density is about 1000 kg/m³; it can serve as a reference for material identification.
map.通过密度对比初判材料真伪（如掺假金属密度偏低）。: Preliminary check of material authenticity by density comparison (e.g. adulterated metal has lower density).
map.m=790 g、V=100 cm³（铁块）→ ρ=7.9 g/cm³ > 水 →: m=790 g, V=100 cm³ (iron block) → ρ=7.9 g/cm³ > water → sinks.
map.多数物质升温膨胀、密度略降。: Most substances expand when heated and their density drops slightly.
map.密度：ρ = m ÷ V（kg/m³，m 质量 kg、V 体积 m³）；联动量：: Density: ρ = m ÷ V (kg/m³, m mass in kg, V volume in m³); linked values: specific volume = 1 ÷ max(ρ,10⁻¹²) (m³/kg), g/cm³ = ρ ÷ 1000, lb/ft³ = ρ × 0.062428. Validation: both m and V are required; V as the denominator must not be 0. Grading: no fixed tiers; when ρ≥100 the result is shown rounded, otherwise to three decimal places.
